description: Reconcile an AI vendor's per-resolution bill against your own records: which billed units sort into matched, disputed (your ledger shows it reopened), unmatched, uncounted (a person rejected it) or outside coverage, and the disputed amount. A pure function over the lines you pass: reads nothing, stores nothing, needs no key. Paste the bill lines and your ledger events.

billed.description: The vendor's bill lines for the period.

external_id.description: The vendor's id for the unit (ticket id).

covered_spans.description: The spans your records cover; omitted = nothing is covered.

ledger.description: Every ledger event you hold for the vendor (reopens after the period still dispute).

rejected_ids.description: External ids your records show as rejected (a person overturned it).

resolved_ids.description: External ids your records show as resolved by the agent.

name: metrx_check_vendor_bill
title: Check Vendor Bill
